taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: BigQuery authorized view/routine data projection and delegation
controls.source_trace: Follow whether a caller can modify an authorized view/routine or use its projection to access data beyond the intended exposure contract.
controls.implementation_branch: Determine whether a view, routine or authorized dataset grants deliberate access to a projection without source-table read rights. Track who can modify that trusted object and its SQL. A user querying the intended view is expected; the defect is excess rows/columns or untrusted modification that changes the delegated projection.
controls.operational_method: Record whether delegation targets one authorized view, one authorized routine or an authorized dataset that can include future views. Identify who may create/replace the delegated object and which dataset/table projection it can query. Compare a fixed permitted projection with a changed projection authored by the actual restricted editor. Metadata visibility is not source-table read access; authorized creation within a delegated dataset can be a separate authority path from editing a single view.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned synthetic datasets and compare intended view output with a controlled modification or restricted direct-table query.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Reading an intentionally public aggregate is expected; table metadata or a denied direct query does not prove excessive view authority.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain authorized-resource modification and projection, then verify intended queries and protected fields remain unavailable.
